book.title: 2 Tesalonaika Tesalonaikanindva Puerati Vriv, Mendeklina Prolmba Mendah.

content: Sembayang Vewuvunvm Kamoa.

Seh, moa eunumbulm kava yemba isholm vinv, yeoa sembayang vewuvunvm kamoa. Sembayang vivm, osm mendeklina moaoa nungi lelnam lehra vethangara pethamoa. Wo eva veo, osm sembayang vivm, indhanamba si mendekli nihil vreuhra no moamba, os ten pev vinnam.
Wo veo, sembayang vivm, osm Sesoava kamba si dandwona vewol vevra indhanakoklanindnapenamba. Mindnamba indhanamba undnahonamba amnavmoa mendeklimba.
Wo heva os mendekliva si wohvevav, nomba hevpa temba wohonamba, velmba. Himba si daswolvav yemba alamba, wo dandwona vewol vevra Setannapenamba.
Mendekli iana kamba, osmba beswonam levrapivolna, osoa yimba wohviv nomba manimani, temba kava wuhtvpa yemba, velmba. Wo kava ningv, os yimba si wohviluwulkovvav manam manam, honamba velmba.
Kava sembayang vewuv, osm mendekliva si pepeisha vewol vinvra nengavnangva yenamba, levrapivolalm, Sesoana und vewol velm, eva Kristusna wevsam, noi ten nis moahui hev kinm vranam.
Indkumbi Andraoa Vivm.

Seh, mendekli Yesus Kristusnashara yemba kava wuhtv, ehalla vinvm indanam pevna mongawa Kristusnindnapenam, ten he andram aivo vivm. Indhanamba temba nomba andramba aivo vivpa, himba engivmoa moamba, nomba temba kava deiswilvnamba hemba.
Yimba pev nonora av, osva kaoa os eva aevulvrata, ten Poltatana aevulvm. Kava aivovo vivnamoa, nonamba kava yemba wonaevulvnamba, owai.
Wo nonamba kava hleinvnamba mongnindna innemba, kava nomba sovawol velvohvna. Kava andra vivna diandrava, osm ata eva manara kava kinmba vrahunta yemba mongomba. Kava andra vivna os sinim okombanam.

Kava ata doarava sahonamba ovuvtamoa, sahowol velmba yemba, osmba kam kolvrowol vivm innepetanamoa. Heva os owai, kava yemba sahowol vinnamoa, kav andra vivna kavna englana, kavmba nonapopolmba aevulalmba, memba osm, yeoa honam nunglirava, eva yeoa os viuta.
Nonamba kava temba yemba wonaevnamba, kava honi lohohmomba vrahunna yemba, mongova indhanariniva andramba vemba owai vevrava, himba si nevramoa innemba.
Wo kava hellemb vena, os yimba monglava ambo aivo viv, andramba. Himba ambo nism aevulalmangasm vev. Wo himba hevmba dem wehasuv vev mongla indhanana moaram.
Kava ovunv no indhanamba, moahuim andra velm, wo nengand vrelm innem hevm. Mendekli Yesus Kristusnashara kava wuhtv hemba, osmba velmba.
Seh, manam yimba aivo vivav, velmba beswonamba.

Himba nomba mongova engmba owai vevrava honamba, memba kava yemba ishunvpa hona tombairava, wo wohkek vithu, an himba hevpa. Yimba manam kuva anisvra vevav hemongova mongawulmba. Heoa wohlou vera noindaoa.
Wo heva os yimba manam indkokla vrivra ungundrinimsnamba hemba. Onguwilvm hemoa pevna mongawatindirinimsna.
Eunillava Polva Moamba Honi Okingpieinna.
Kava sembayang venav os, mendekli yemba si wonvevra undwonamba almba besalva elsus, eva os notongora, notongora yunalm. Manara he plalva honanamba os. Eva mendeklioa yemoa wonavrata indkumbimoa.
Kava Pol, wo doa kava vipiai honamba eunilmomba, men kavna englanamba. Kava os novol vewol velohv snal moamba, memba osm yunam temba kana tombaiva. Men hona wevsana monana kava novol vewol velohv.
Doa pivna mendekli Yesus Kristus yemoa indkumbimoa wavra vovhueinda. Doata.
